item.tib: yang dag rin chen sgron ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs
item.coloph: bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gtso bos/ gto bu 'bum sangs la brgyud/ gto bus lha bon yongs su dag pa la brgyud/ yongs su dag pas dbra btsun bdag la brgyud/ bdag gis ma bur tshang bar dkar chag yi ger btab/ 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mkhyen pa can la bshags/ bla ma bder gshegs rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs rnams kyi 'phrag dog mi mdzad zhu/ u ya swa mA yA rgya rgya rgya 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba dri med des/ pha ma'i gtsor byas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ sgrib sbyang tshogs rdzogs 'khor ba dong sprug nas/ bon nyid dbyings su rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog/
